Class ArduinoUno

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.ArduinoUno
public final class ArduinoUno extends Object
The Arduino UNO board's microcontroller unit (MCU): its Gpio pins, its I2c bus, its USB Mouse, its built-in LedMatrix, its onboard Wifi, its Clock, which board it is (BoardModel) and its arena and flash figures (BoardMemory). Each getter returns the same instance every call, backed by the compiler's intrinsics. Get them once, at startup, and pass them to the classes that need them; a unit test passes mock(Gpio.class), mock(I2c.class), mock(Mouse.class), mock(LedMatrix.class), mock(Wifi.class), mock(Clock.class), mock(BoardModel.class) or mock(BoardMemory.class) instead.
